researchNotes:
LICENSE: matches id 'tpbank' in data/licensed-institutions.json (NHTM Cổ phần). TPBank is on the licensed list. The list's licenseNumber reads 'Giấy phép số 23/GP-NHNN ngày 25/5/2026'.
RATES: No product-level lending rate (cash loan, salary loan, overdraft) is published on any tpb.vn page that could be read; pages say rates depend on the customer profile. Stored only as kind 'benchmark': TPBank base lending rate for individuals (%/năm): 1 month 9.65, 3 months 11.00, 6 months 11.10, 12 months 11.20 (https://tpb.vn/cong-cu-tinh-toan/lai-suat, PDF Bieu LSCS danh cho KHCN_15.10.2026); it is not what a borrower pays. NOT used: third-party or old figures that disagree with each other (1.6%/tháng and 70 triệu/36 tháng in a VPBank comparison blog; 8.7-8.9%/năm and 300 triệu in a Techcombank blog; 0.6%/tháng in an undated tapchicongthuong.vn article; 1.6%/tháng and 10.8%/năm in tpb.vn cẩm nang articles about 3-4 years old).
CONFLICTS (also in conflicts[]): overdraft limit 500 triệu (product body) vs 100 triệu (title, listing) -> 100 triệu stored; salary loan limit 1 tỷ (product page) vs 300 triệu (listing) -> 300 triệu stored; TPFico early settlement 7/5/3% (2022 notice) vs TPBank schedule 3/1.5% (08/2026) -> the 2022 figure not stored.
TPFICO: lender of record not verified on the product page; hotline differs (TPFico 1900 63 66 33 vs TPBank 1900 58 58 85). All three products are excluded from ranking: none has a published product rate.
FEE SCHEDULE: Phụ lục 02 - Biểu phí vay và phạt (08/2026) was read with pdftotext; encoding is garbled but numbers are legible. Phụ lục 04 Biểu phí dịch vụ tín dụng and the general loan T&Cs exist on tpb.vn but were not parsed, so fees are partial.
NOT COVERED: credit-card installment, Kredivo loan, Vay mua hàng trả góp, ShopeePay loan, Momo Pay-later limit T&C (2021 PDF unreadable). Mortgages, car and business loans skipped by instruction.
INSURANCE: only the TPFico loan insurance formula was found (2.5%/year on 140% or 110% of the loan). Whether it is optional or mandatory, and how it is collected, is unknown.
MISC: tpb.vn footers say copyright 2024 while content is current (fee schedule 08/2026, deposit rate table effective 19/10/2026). Page title and body text can differ (overdraft).
